n: Front Load Electric Dryer with Extra Power and Quick Dry cycle - 7.3 cu. ft.
desc: Dry large loads in this 7.3 cu. ft. capacity Maytag® front load dryer. Extra Power boosts drying power to get thick fabrics drier the first time,* while Advanced Moisture Sensing helps evenly dry loads.
hl: The Extra Power button boosts drying power on any cycle by extending time, heat and tumbling*.
Advanced Moisture Sensing monitors inside moisture and air temperatures to help evenly dry loads.
The Quick Dry cycle dries small loads fast.
Dry even your largest loads with a spacious 7.3 cu. ft. capacity.

We don't just tell you a Maytag® dryer will get your clothes dry for years: we confidently back our dryers with a 10-year limited parts warranty* on the drive motor and drum. *Visit maytag.com for warranty details.
We take pride in building strong, reliable appliances for your home.
